items: Replying to reviews takes time, so it helps to know whether a higher reply rate lifts your star rating and whether a higher rating lifts revenue.
Momos tested the first link with its own analysis of Google review data across 504 brands, looking at how reply rate relates to rating.
For the second link, the post draws on research by Michael Luca of Harvard Business School on what happens to revenue when a rating rises.
Treat review replies as part of your revenue plan for every location and follow the playbook at the end of the post.
